prompt: A compound with formula C₄H₈O shows: IR 1715 cm⁻¹ (strong), no broad O-H; ¹H NMR 2.1 ppm (s, 3H), 2.5 ppm (q, 2H), 1.0 ppm (t, 3H). Identify it.
explanation: IR 1715 (C=O), no broad O-H rules out the alcohol. Butanal would show an aldehyde H at δ ~9.7 (not seen) plus a C-H doublet in IR at 2720/2820. THF has no C=O. 2-butanone fits: 2.1 ppm singlet (CH₃ α to C=O), 2.5 quartet (CH₂ α to C=O), 1.0 triplet (terminal CH₃).
